svg.aria-label: Graphic placement schematic for an ACG Dri-FIT tee concept, Lagazuoi Year Two, size M base, front and back views with measured callouts
svg.text: ACG DRI-FIT TEE, LOOSE · LAGAZUOI, YEAR TWO · CONCEPT FOR NEXT SEASON · SIZE M BASE · ALL DIMENSIONS IN INCHES · DRAWN TO SCALE
Chest 44 (1 in below armhole, loose fit)
Left chest: ACG mark, 1.25 x 1.1, high-density heat transfer, matte white
Center 3 in below HPS, 3.5 in from CF. Placement tolerance +/- 0.25
Neck: 7/8 in 1x1 rib, self fabric, black. Neck width 7.5, front drop 3.25
Ink A Contour lines, green, 1 to 1.5 mm line weight
Ink B Tunnel route and summit markers, bone
Repeat 12 x 12, rotary screen on open-width fabric before cutting
Free match at seams, print direction up, see tile at right
Water-based ink, soft hand, no cracking after 20 washes
Side seam: flatlock, no vents, pattern free match
Dri-FIT jersey, 63% polyester / 37% cotton, 200 gsm, black
Loose fit: 3 in ease over Nike M body chest 41
Back neck hit: LAGAZUOI · 2778 M, 3.5 x 0.5, one color, Ink B screen print
1.5 in below CB neck seam, centered.
ACG woven label, 1.25 x 0.5, left hem, sewn 4 sides, 1 in from side seam
Care label: left interior side seam, 2 in below armhole
Contours: Monte Lagazuoi, simplified from map data
Route: the tunnel network, dashed, with portal rings
Year one printed the tunnels. Year two prints the view.
Ink A green, match to current ACG Cave Dweller green
ACG DRI-FIT TEE · LAGAZUOI, YEAR TWO
Graphic placement schematic · Size M base · Concept for next season · Rev 1.0 · Self-initiated concept, not a Nike document
Graded spec XS to 4XL Tall. Tall adds 1.75 to body length.
Interior: tagless heat-transfer size and care label at CB neck
